body:
## Pull request overview

This PR closes several spec-compliance gaps by adding dashboard auto-refresh support, introducing a pluggable schema persistence hook for the designer, and hardening rendering via per-component error boundaries in `SchemaRenderer`.

**Changes:**
- Add `refreshInterval?: number` to `DashboardSchema` and implement manual + timer-based refresh in dashboard renderers.
- Add `useSchemaPersistence` hook with a `SchemaPersistenceAdapter` interface and a default `localStorage` adapter.
- Wrap each rendered schema component in a `SchemaErrorBoundary`, plus add/expand tests and update compliance/roadmap docs.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 11 out of 11 changed files in this pull request and generated 10 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/complex.ts | Extends `DashboardSchema` with `refreshInterval` for auto-refresh configuration. |
| packages/react/src/hooks/useSchemaPersistence.ts | Adds persistence hook + adapter interface + default localStorage adapter. |
| packages/react/src/hooks/index.ts | Re-exports `useSchemaPersistence` from the hooks barrel. |
| packages/react/src/hooks/__tests__/useSchemaPersistence.test.ts | Adds tests for persistence hook and localStorage adapter behavior. |
| packages/react/src/__tests__/SchemaRenderer.errorBoundary.test.tsx | Adds tests for error boundary fallback/isolation behavior. |
| packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx | Implements and integrates per-component `SchemaErrorBoundary`. |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardRenderer.autoRefresh.test.tsx | Adds tests covering manual refresh, interval refresh, and interval cleanup. |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx | Adds Refresh All UI + interval-based refresh in dashboard renderer. |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardGridLayout.tsx | Adds Refresh All UI + interval-based refresh in grid layout dashboard variant. |
| SPEC_COMPLIANCE_EVALUATION.md | Updates compliance status and progress tracking narrative. |
| ROADMAP.md | Updates test count (but currently leaves conflicting older counts elsewhere in the doc). |
</details>
The Retry button is missing an explicit `type="button"`. If SchemaRenderer is rendered inside a form, the default button type can submit the form unexpectedly when clicking Retry.

`Component` is imported from React and then a local `const Component = ComponentRegistry.get(...)` is declared later in the same module, which creates confusing shadowing. Consider avoiding the named import (use `React.Component` in the error boundary) or rename the resolved registry component variable (e.g., `ResolvedComponent`).

SchemaErrorBoundary state will persist even if the rendered schema/type changes on subsequent renders, so a previously-crashed component can stay stuck showing the fallback (and may even show a stale error for a new componentType). Consider resetting the boundary when `evaluatedSchema.id`/`evaluatedSchema.type` changes (e.g., key the boundary by those values or implement a props-change reset).

`handleRefresh` schedules a `setTimeout` to clear the refreshing state but never cancels it on unmount. This can trigger state updates after unmount (especially during route changes). Store the timeout id in a ref and clear it in the effect cleanup/unmount path.

This test overrides `window.localStorage` at module scope but never restores the original implementation. Since Vitest runs tests in a shared environment, this can leak into other test files. Consider capturing the original localStorage and restoring it in an afterAll/afterEach, or use `vi.stubGlobal('localStorage', ...)` with proper cleanup.
`fireEvent` is imported but not used in this test file, which adds noise and can trigger unused-import linting in some setups.

The test case name says the Retry button "resets the error", but it only asserts that the button exists. This leaves the actual retry/reset behavior unverified. Consider updating the test to click Retry and assert the boundary re-attempts rendering (e.g., using a component that throws once and then renders successfully).

`handleRefresh` schedules a `setTimeout` to clear the refreshing state but never cancels it on unmount. This can cause "setState on unmounted component" warnings if the dashboard unmounts during the 600ms window. Store the timeout id in a ref and clear it in the effect cleanup/unmount path.

createLocalStorageAdapter uses JSON.parse on localStorage values without guarding against malformed/corrupted data (e.g., the index or schema entry). A bad value will throw and break save/load/list/delete calls. Consider wrapping parses in try/catch and falling back to safe defaults (e.g., empty index / null schema) to make the adapter more resilient.

ROADMAP.md now states "All 42 builds pass, all 3185+ tests pass" here, but the Executive Summary above still says "41/41 builds pass" and "2961/2961 tests pass". Please update the earlier counts too so the document is internally consistent.
